subject: E-3307: quota exceeded on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.6, macOS 15.3. Since last week, every time I start a sync, I get "E-3307: storage quota exceeded".

Our quota includes a large folder a partner company shared with us. Their folder alone is larger than our whole plan.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Ivan Petrov (Brightwater Clinics)
